newsitem.title: USA: SierraWest to acquire Mercantile Bank.
newsitem.headline: SierraWest to acquire Mercantile Bank.

text.p: SierraWest Bancorp on Friday said it signed a definitive agreement to acquire Mercantile Bank, a Sacramento, Calif.-based business bank primarily serving commercial and real estate loan industries.
Mercantile Bank, with total assets of $45 million, will be merged into SierraWest's SierraWest Bank unit.
The deal, which is scheduled to close in June, is expected to have a positive effect on SierraWest's 1997 earnings.
Under the agreement, Mercantile shareholders will receive a total $6.6 million, half in cash and half in shares of SierraWest.
The deal will increase SierraWest's total assets to more than $500 million and its deposit base in Sacramento to more than $85 million.
SierraWest shares were unchanged at 17 in early afternoon trading on the Nasdaq.
